name: Angel, Newborn Astral Deva
source: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary
book: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary

facets.bk: The Genius Guide to the Talented Bestiary

body:
This human-like creature has long feathery wings and youthful exuberance.

Newborn Astral Deva CR 6

XP 2,400
Skilled
NG Medium outsider (angel, extraplanar, good)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +13
Aura protective aura

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+4 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 73 (7d8+42)
Fort +8, Ref +9, Will +7; +4 vs. poison, +4 resistance vs. evil
Defensive Abilities uncanny dodge; DR 5/evil; Immune acid, cold, petrification; Resist electricity 10, fire 10; SR 17

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee +1 warhammer +11 (1d8+6/x3), slam +5 (1d8+2)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7, concentration +10)

At will–detect evil
3/day–cure light wounds, detect evil, invisibility (self only), remove fear
1/day–aid, plane shift

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 18, Con 22, Int 17, Wis 17, Cha 17
Base Atk +5; CMB +10; CMD 24
Feats Cleave, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Acrobatics +14, Diplomacy +13, Fly +18, Intimidate +13, Knowledge (planes, religion) +13, Perception +13, Sense Motive +13, Stealth +14
Languages Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; truespeech
SQ change shape (alter self)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

This ability functions as the rogue ability. If the newborn astral deva gains uncanny dodge from a class level, he instead gains improved uncanny dodge.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure standard (+1 warhammer)

When the soul of a good person creates a newborn astral deva, their fellows encourage the outsider to travel the planes. These explorers inspire and lead others towards noble causes. Unfortunately, the newborns often find themselves in desperate situations, or taken advantage of by the powerful. The typical newborn astral deva looks human except for its wings, though some look like other humanoid races. A rare few have even more unusual forms.

A newborn astral deva is 6 feet tall and weighs 200 pounds.
